title: Sales Development Representative - San Francisco
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Sales Development Representative at Cursor, you'll be the tip of the spear for pipeline generation, the first voice a prospective customer hears, and the person who earns their attention before an Account Executive ever gets on a call. You'll work across the full range of our commercial segments, from fast-moving startups to mid-market engineering organizations, identifying the right buyers and creating the conditions for meaningful sales conversations.

This isn't a role for someone who waits for leads to come in. You'll build pipeline from scratch, learn how great engineering teams think, and develop a deep understanding of how Cursor transforms developer productivity. It's the fastest way to learn enterprise sales at one of the most exciting companies in AI.

 

What you'll do

- Generate qualified pipeline for our Account Executive team through high-volume outbound prospecting, including cold calls, personalized emails, LinkedIn, and creative multi-channel sequences

- Research target accounts and map stakeholders across Engineering, Product, and Leadership to identify the right entry points

- Conduct discovery conversations that go beyond surface-level qualification, understand how development teams work, what's slowing them down, and where Cursor fits

- Partner closely with AEs to develop account strategies, hand off opportunities cleanly, and stay looped in as deals progress

- Hit and exceed weekly activity targets and monthly qualified meeting goals

- Represent Cursor's brand and product with conviction; you'll be many prospects' first impression of the company

- Bring market intelligence back to the team: what resonates, what objections are coming up, what messaging is landing

- Help build the playbook. As an early SDR, your patterns and learnings will shape how this function scales

 

You may be a fit if

- You have 1-2 years of experience in a sales, customer-facing, or business development role. SDR/BDR experience at a SaaS or developer tools company is a strong plus

- You're a relentless self-starter who takes ownership of your pipeline and doesn't wait to be handed leads

- You write and speak with clarity. You can explain a complex product simply and tailor your message to a technical audience

- You're curious about how software gets built and excited by the idea that AI is fundamentally changing the craft

- You're organized and data-driven: you track your activity, learn from your numbers, and iterate quickly

- You have thick skin and genuine resilience. You don't take rejection personally and you bounce back fast

- You want to grow into an Account Executive role and are willing to put in the reps to get there

title: Young Ambassador (Volunteer)
description:
Here at Youth4Youth , we have grown a strong, tight-knit community of individuals who are passionate about making a difference and improving the lives of young people across the UK. Our growing team of volunteers all contribute, significantly, to the impact that we have as a charity on our direct beneficiaries, regardless of the department that they work in of the level of time that they are able to commit. Our services primarily offer a peer-support network to young people right across the UK, allowing them to access a peer mentor who is of a similar age to them and somebody that they feel more comfortable speaking with.
If successful, you will be joining a growing team of diverse, but likeminded individuals, collaborating to increase the reach of the Charity and improve support provisions available to young people. All of our volunteers and employees are remote workers, but that doesn't stop us keeping in touch and maintaining a strong positive culture amongst our whole team.
About the role
Here at Youth4Youth, we hugely value involving young people in decisions made about how the charity supports young people. We are pleased that we continue to build the relationship that our Board of Trustees has with young people through our Youth Voice Team.
If you are aged 14 to 25 , this is a great opportunity to join a growing and adaptable youth-focussed charity and make a real impact. As a member of the Youth Voice Team, you will play a key role in providing feedback to the Board of Trustees on the Charity, promote youth voice from within and, ultimately, influence decisions made about the charity and how we remain relevant to the needs of those that we support.
We are happy to help you with any volunteering hours required for programmes such as the Duke of Edinburgh award - let us know when you get started so that we can track your hours and sign them off.
What does our Youth Voice team need from you?

• Attend regular Youth Voice meetings (normally held monthly), where you will play an active role in discussing the current status of the Charity and its growth

• Influence decisions that are made to make sure that we stay relevant to the needs of young people - this includes the general direction of the charity, the services that we offer, the way that we engage with young people and much more!

• Be an ambassador for the charity and share what we do with others (such as your peers and your local community) to gather feedback and insights to help us understand the needs of young people.

• Get involved in other areas that interest you, such as social media, fundraising and much more.

Our mission is to continue to grow towards becoming one of the best charities in the UK. Our aim is to do this by building a diverse team, rich with different backgrounds and perspectives. Therefore, even if you feel you only are a 75% match, we would still love to hear from you. Skills can be learned, but diversity cannot.
Benefits of volunteering with Youth4Youth
We recognise that you will be joining us and giving your time as an 'in-kind' donation, but there must be benefits for you too. When joining our team, you will be open to the following benefits:

• Professional and personal development opportunities in a variety of skill areas through volunteering in real roles. This may be general development or tailored to your specific needs or ambitions

• Becoming a member of a strong network of likeminded individuals, spread across the UK, who you can connect with and collaborate with both within and outside of the Charity

• Access to bespoke discounts, specifically designed for non-profit workers and Youth4Youth volunteers

• Opportunities to truly shape the future of the Charity, having a direct influence over the impact that Youth4Youth has on its direct beneficiaries

The hiring process
Our hiring process typically has two stages

• Video or Written Application (when applicable)

• Interview with the Volunteering Coordinator for that role

description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate , we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.
Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate ’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.
Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.
At Cogstate , we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.
About the Clinician Network
By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.
Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter , which shares updates and upcoming openings.
About the Role
Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.
Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.
*These are contract position.
*They are fully remote.
*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- MADRS Administration Experience Required
- Dutch Fluency Required

Central Rating

• Scoring completed scale administrations.

• Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

• Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.

• Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

• Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment

title: Environmental Test Technician (2nd Shift)
tags: Hardware Platform : Hardware Test Operations : Dev Test
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Enterprise Test Capabilities (ETC) develops, operates, and scales the shared physical test infrastructure, technical expertise, and execution systems required to validate Anduril's products across the company. The team provides specialized testing that is capital-intensive, technically complex, safety-critical, or broadly reusable across multiple programs, spanning environmental testing (thermal, vibration, shock, HALT, TVAC), battery testing (cell/module/pack characterization, abuse testing, BMS validation), propulsion testing (engine test cells, thrust/torque measurement, fuel/feed systems), aerodynamic testing (wind tunnel operations, flow visualization, force/moment measurement), and structural testing. We partner with product test teams from early development through qualification and sustainment to identify technical risk, select appropriate test methods, execute testing safely, and generate trusted engineering evidence. The test operations team within ETC owns the lab facilities, equipment fleet, calibration program, and operational support team that keeps this diverse test enterprise running.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking an Environmental Test Technician to join our rapidly growing environmental test team in Costa Mesa, CA. In this role, you will be responsible for executing a wide variety of climactic and environmental tests on the full spectrum of products developed at Anduril. The ideal candidate brings hands-on test and measurement equipment experience, strong troubleshooting instincts across multiple equipment types, and takes genuine pride in equipment performance and uptime. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Execute a variety of environmental tests including, but not limited to, thermal, dynamic, corrosion, and ingress tests.

• Program test controllers such as WATLOW F4s, and F4Ts.

• Execute dynamic tests using electrodynamic shaker table control software.

• Set up data acquisition systems for environmental tests

• Maintain lab spaces to a high level of organization and professionalism.

• Promote lab safety training and processes, fostering an environment and culture to promote safety as the number one priority

• Promote proper maintenance of capital equipment including environmental chambers, electrodynamic shakers, and data acquisition equipment.

• Advance environmental testing training materials and keep technical documentation updated.

• Travel to test sites and remote labs as needed

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 7+ years of professional experience in a engineering technician capacity or similar

• Familiarity with Jira or other agile development software

• Experience with running environmental test equipment

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, demanding, flexible team environment

• Eligible to obtain / maintain a U.S. Security Clearance

• Familiarity with environmental test standards (MIL-STD-810, DO-160)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Familiarity with NI Data acquisition system setup and collection, as well as running LabVIEW and Flexlogger software.

• Familiarity with VR software including VibrationVIEW and ObserVIEW for executing and processing dynamic tests.

• Demonstrated sense of drive and ability to work in cross-functional teams effectively

title: Lead Analytics Engineer - Data Modeling & Quality
description:
Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world - one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs.
We’re a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable-and we’re looking for passionate people to help us get there.

Why This Role Is Important to Arcadia

Arcadia 's data platform powers population health analytics for health plans, ACOs, and provider groups across the country. As a Lead Analytics Engineer - Data Modeling & Quality, you sit at the intersection of data quality ownership and analytical data modeling. You'll own the SQL and DBT layer that transforms raw clinical and claims data into trusted, production-grade datasets, while also serving as the quality authority for the data those models produce.

This is a hybrid role - deeper SQL and DBT expertise than a traditional Data Health Professional, with a more analytical and model-focused scope than a Data Engineering role. You're less focused on pipeline infrastructure and more on the logic, shape, and trustworthiness of the data itself.

What Success Looks Like

In 3 months

• Independently triage and resolve pipeline data quality issues

• Author at least one new DBT model or refactor an existing one to meet current modeling standards

• Design a DBT test suite for a set of models lacking coverage

• Understand the end-to-end pipeline from ingress through silver and gold, and be able to trace a data quality issue to its root layer

In 6 months

• Building strong working relationships with clients and cross-functional partners (Data Engineering, Customer Success)

• Deeply familiar with Arcadia 's full data stack - from ingress through silver, gold, and downstream consumers

• Driving at least one improvement project forward, whether technical (e.g. model refactor, new DQ framework) or process-focused (e.g. promotion playbook, triage workflow)

In 12 months

• Recognized as a leader within the department - peers and stakeholders seek out your expertise on data modeling and quality

• Operating independently across the full scope of the role with minimal guidance

• Two or more improvement projects completed and in production, with measurable impact on data quality or operational efficiency

What You'll Be Doing

DATA MODELING & DBT DEVELOPMENT

• Author, review, and maintain DBT models using Spark/Hudi from ingest through bronze and silver

• Help clients understand their data model, assumptions, and limitations through intentional validation

• Troubleshoot and fix issues, then write DBT tests to catch issues proactively

• Optimize SQL performance for slow-running jobs

• Partner with Data Engineering on Hudi table design, partition strategy, and incremental patterns
DATA QUALITY OWNERSHIP

• Triage and classify data quality alerts, distinguishing source-level issues from transform-layer failures

• Design and maintain volume monitors and DQ monitors (null rate, distribution, future-date checks)

• Author and apply clinical DQ rules (entity volume, field coverage, LOINC coverage, referential integrity) and claims validation rules across silver and gold layers

• Conduct quality reviews for connector promotions - evaluating silver entity coverage, validation rule pass rates, and bronze-to-silver transformation correctness

• Own the ticket queue for DQ, attribution, hierarchy, and customer-specific data quality issues, writing clear customer-facing findings
CROSS-FUNCTIONAL QUALITY COLLABORATION

• Lead data quality reviews during connector installation and promotion (UAT → PRD), including claims validation playbooks and null analysis

• Partner with Data Engineering on root-cause triage for errors, ingress anomalies, and silver table issues surfaced through data quality monitoring

• Fluent in English, both oral and written, and comfortable working in Python.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• A PhD from a leading university in a STEM related discipline, with 3+ years of research in computational science in combination with AI.

title: Staff Product Designer, Guest & Discovery
description:
Staff Product Designer, Guest & Discovery

Company

Collaborative Boating operates Boatsetter and GetMyBoat, the two largest marketplaces for getting on the water, now converging into one platform. Guests arrive wanting something specific - a fishing trip, a sunset cruise, a birthday on a pontoon - and we connect them to the captains, operators, and owners who can make it happen. Finding and booking a day outside should be as easy and intuitive as booking a flight.

The problem

Search is changing under us. Guests arrive with intent expressed in natural language, increasingly through an AI assistant instead of a search box, and increasingly on a surface we don't own. Answering that with a chatbot is the obvious move and the wrong one: choosing between boats is a parallel, visual, comparison task, and a conversation is sequential. The work is holding both - a visual discovery experience built for comparison, and a compact, structured expression of a listing that holds up when a third-party assistant renders it in a layout we didn't design.

The center of gravity is the search results card. It's the smallest unit of persuasion we have: a handful of facts, ordered, that a guest uses to decide whether to look closer. Which facts earn a place, in what order, and how that adapts from "boat rental Miami" to "something fun for eight people Saturday" - that's the problem. It's an information design problem before it's a visual one.

What you'll own

•
The end-to-end guest discovery experience - search, filtering and refinement, results, map and list, the listing page, and the paths in from organic search and AI assistants. Coherence across both brands and web plus mobile is yours.

•
The information hierarchy of the results card, defended with evidence, across guest intents and every state the data actually produces: missing photos, no reviews yet, a price range instead of a price, partial availability.

•
Interfaces over a system that infers. Make what it inferred legible, make correcting it easy, and reduce verification labor rather than creating it - a guest who has to double-check our answer has been handed our work.

•
Surfaces we don't render. With engineering, shape the structured expression of an experience, an offer, and an operator so it survives being summarized, quoted, or laid out by someone else's assistant.

•
Continuous discovery with your pod - a Product Manager and an engineering tech lead. Choose the cheapest artifact that answers the open question; spend fidelity when a decision is actually being committed.

How we work

Five things worth knowing before you apply. They aren't universal, and here they aren't negotiable.

Problem, then system, then experience

We frame the problem, then settle the shape of the system - entities, states, edge cases - and only then design the experience within it. Your rough exploration runs alongside the system design and improves it; committed fidelity comes later. In practice that means days of useful work before there's a screen worth showing, and arguing about data models with your tech lead while the design is still loose. If you need a settled brief before you can start, this will be frustrating.

Discovery is ongoing, not a handed off spec

You talk to guests and operators directly. You bring opportunities forward rather than receiving them. There's no research team handing you findings and no Product Manager writing you requirements - the pod owns the outcome and you're one third of it. We believe the commercial results follow from understanding these customers better than anyone else does, which is why the understanding isn't delegated to a function.

We ask what moved, not what shipped

You define the signal before release and watch it after. Hitting the number you set is the floor, not the finish - the work worth remembering beat it, and we'd rather you aim at that and miss than aim at the floor and land. Sometimes the answer is that your design didn't work, you say so plain

description:

Joining Legora means three things.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

THE ROLE

This is the most senior seat on the advisory ladder and the person our largest clients trust when it matters most. In legal AI, that trust is hard-won: matters run to fixed dates, data is privileged, and clients hold Legora to the same standard of care they apply to their own work. - Coordinate escalations: Align the Platform Consultants and the Technical Platform Expert around a single resolution path, holding customer-facing ownership while technical root cause is driven in parallel.

- Stay close to the signal: Own the highest-stakes cases in the L2 queue for your assigned Strategic Accounts, and serve as the escalation point for Platform Consultants before an issue reaches the Technical Platform Expert, so you stay close to the ground truth of each account's technical health.

WHAT YOU BRING

- You have owned strategic, high-value B2B accounts and kept clients confident when things went wrong.

- You have led incident response or major escalations under pressure, start to finish.

- You communicate with executives as clearly as with engineers: confirmed facts, explicit trade-of

title: Infrastructure Operations & Sustainability Lead
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Industrial Compute organization is building and operating the infrastructure required to support frontier AI at unprecedented scale. The organization works across data center development, power, design and construction, hardware, supply chain, deployment, facilities operations, and external partnerships.

As this infrastructure footprint grows, OpenAI must ensure that sustainability, operational reliability, and responsible development are incorporated into infrastructure decisions from the beginning rather than addressed as separate downstream initiatives.

About the Role

We are seeking an Infrastructure Operations & Sustainability Lead to develop and execute the sustainability strategy for OpenAI’s global infrastructure portfolio.

This role will translate environmental priorities and external commitments into practical operating requirements across site selection, data center design, construction, equipment procurement, deployment, and ongoing operations. You will build the frameworks, metrics, governance, and cross-functional programs required to improve environmental performance while preserving the speed, reliability, and scalability demanded by OpenAI’s infrastructure roadmap.

The role will partner closely with infrastructure operations, site development, engineering, construction, power, hardware, supply chain, finance, legal, public policy, government affairs, communications, and external infrastructure partners.

This is a senior leadership role requiring infrastructure fluency, sustainability expertise, executive judgment, and the ability to drive complex initiatives across organizational boundaries.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain a comprehensive sustainability strategy for OpenAI’s global compute infrastructure.

- Translate sustainability objectives into actionable requirements for site selection, design, construction, procurement, commissioning, and operations.

- Establish decision frameworks that balance environmental impact with infrastructure reliability, deployment speed, cost, and scalability.

- Develop strategies addressing operational and embodied carbon, water stewardship, materials, construction impacts, waste, circularity, and equipment lifecycle management.

- Partner with data center engineering and operations teams to identify practical improvements in infrastructure efficiency, resource use, resilience, and operational performance.

- Incorporate sustainability considerations into self-build, colocation, cloud, and strategic infrastructure-partner decisions.

- Establish measurable goals, operating metrics, dashboards, and governance mechanisms for infrastructure sustainability programs.

- Improve the quality, consistency, and auditability of environmental and operational data across internal teams and external partners.

- Work with hardware, manufacturing, and supply chain teams to develop supplier requirements and lifecycle strategies for infrastructure equipment.

- Evaluate emerging technologies, design approaches, and operating practices and determine which should move from pilot programs into scaled deployment.

- Develop business cases that clearly communicate environmental impact, implementation requirements, cost, schedule, and operational tradeoffs.

- Partner with Public Policy and Government Affairs on infrastructure-related sustainability positions, regulatory developments, and external engagement.

- Represent OpenAI in conversations with infrastructure partners, industry organizations, policymakers, community stakeholders, and other external parties.

- Provide executive leadership with clear assessments of progress, material risks, strategic choices, and recommended actions.

- Build repeatable playbooks that allow sustainability practices to scale across sites, geographies, infrastructure partners, and technology generations.

Qualifications

- 12+ years of experience in sustainability, infrastructure operations, environmental strategy,

description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

- Close at the speed of the build, not the speed of finance. Capital has to land in lockstep with gigawatts coming online: multiple landmark transactions running at once, on timelines most banks would call impossible. You'll redefine how fast serious capital can move.

title: Turbine Technician - Memphis
description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

SpaceXAI is seeking a Turbine Technician to operate, maintain, and troubleshoot gas turbine generator packages at our power generation facility. This is a hands-on role: you will inspect running turbine packages, support start-up and shutdown, respond to trips and alarms, restore equipment, and keep generation online. You will work across the turbine, generator, and package auxiliaries - following OEM procedures, site MOPs, and engineering direction in a fast-paced environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Operate, inspect, and maintain gas turbine generator packages (including Solar and 6000-class units) and associated auxiliaries: lube oil, hydraulic, fuel gas, inlet air, enclosure ventilation, cooling, fire/gas detection, and generator systems

• Support turbine start-up, loading, shutdown, cooldown, and turning-gear operations per OEM and site procedures

• Perform daily inspections of turbines and package systems; identify leaks, vibration, temperature, and alarm issues early and self-report before they affect generation

• Troubleshoot and repair operational issues on turbine packages during normal operation, start-up, trips, outages, or commissioning

• Adjust, repair, or replace faulty mechanical, electrical, and controls components on turbines, generators, and package auxiliaries

• Assist with maintenance and troubleshooting of turbine control systems, including OEM turbine controllers, PLC, HMI, and SCADA interfaces

• Write, follow, and execute MOPs, SOPs, and EOPs; support lockout/tagout, hot work, confined space, and site safety and environmental requirements

• Support scheduled turbine outages: filter changes, inspections, OEM work, system isolation, and return-to-service

• Support commissioning by witnessing turbine start-up, assisting with functional testing, and monitoring turnover

• Read and interpret P&IDs, OEM manuals, schematics, and drawings; coordinate with operations, maintenance, and engineering to restore the turbine and keep generation online

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 3+ years of hands-on experience as a technician or operator working on gas turbines, rotating equipment, or industrial mechanical, electrical, and/or control systems

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience operating or maintaining gas turbines (Solar, 6000-class, or similar) in a power plant or industrial generation setting

• Experience with turbine auxiliaries (lube oil, fuel gas, inlet filtration, enclosure systems) and generator systems

• Experience writing and executing MOPs, SOPs, and EOPs

• Experience troubleshooting turbine equipment, including OEM turbine control interfaces and PLC/HMI/SCADA

• Associate’s degree in a technical field (e.g., Power Plant Technology, Turbine Technology, Mechatronics) or equivalent experience

• Strong documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in a team environment

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be able to lift at least 25 lbs (unassisted), climb ladders, and work in confined spaces

• Must be willing to travel up to 25%. Position is based at a SpaceX power generation facility; work at other SpaceX sites for extended periods

title: Preparador/a de oposiciones de Fuerzas y Cuerpos de Seguridad del Estado (Policí
description:
🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy

¿Eres policía, guardia civil, funcionario/a de prisiones o preparas estas oposiciones? Colabora en remoto con Polaris x Ucademy y ayuda a otros a conseguir su plaza.
📚 Oposiciones para las que buscamos preparadores

• Policía Nacional (Escala Básica)

• Guardia Civil (Escala de Cabos y Guardias)

• Policía Municipal de Madrid

• Policía Local de Andalucía

• Policía Local de la Comunitat Valenciana

• Ayudante de Instituciones Penitenciarias (Subgrupo C1)

• Otras oposiciones de FYCSE

🌟 Quiénes somos
En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros .
Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento .
Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia . La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.
🔎 A quién buscamos

• Agentes y funcionarios/as en activo o en excedencia (Policía Nacional, Guardia Civil, policías locales o Instituciones Penitenciarias) y preparadores/as de estas oposiciones.

• Personas que conozcan el proceso completo por dentro : temario, psicotécnicos, ortografía, pruebas físicas, entrevista personal y reconocimiento médico.

• Quienes sepan enseñar y acompañar : explicar con claridad, dar feedback útil y ayudar a sostener la preparación hasta el final.

• Soltura con herramientas digitales . Si ya utilizas IA en tu día a día, mucho mejor.

🎯 En qué podrás colaborar
Según tu perfil, especialidad y disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos:

• Clases online dinámicas, prácticas y cercanas.

• Temario y actualización normativa , clave en estas convocatorias.

• Preguntas tipo test, psicotécnicos y simulacros con el formato real del examen.

• Preparación de las pruebas físicas: planes de entrenamiento, técnica y seguimiento.

• Entrevista personal y pruebas de personalidad: simulacros y feedback.

• Seguimiento de alumnos: resolver dudas y ayudarles a avanzar.

• Vídeos cortos, esquemas y resúmenes.

🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración
No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educativos concretos , compatible con tu actividad profesional.
Si estás en activo, no te pedimos que dejes tu puesto . Queremos que pongas tu experiencia al servicio de otros opositores de una forma flexible.
🌍 100 % remoto
🕐 Horarios y disponibilidad a convenir
📚 Proyectos y entregables definidos desde el inicio
💰 Compensación competitiva según el proyecto y los entregables
🎬 Cómo es el proceso de selección
Queremos conocerte enseñando , no solo leyendo tu CV. El proceso tiene cuatro pasos:
1. Revisión de perfil. En la candidatura responderás a unas preguntas breves y nos enviarás un vídeo de presentación de 1 minuto . Grábalo con el móvil, sin complicaciones: cuéntanos quién eres, tu experiencia y qué oposición dominas.
2. Contacto de validación. Si tu perfil encaja, nos pondremos en contacto contigo por llamada o por escrito para resolver dudas, conocer tu disponibilidad y explicarte cómo colaboramos.
3. Clase de prueba. Te pediremos que nos envíes una clase grabada de máximo 5 minutos sobre un concepto de tu oposición, con un material de apoyo creado por ti. No buscamos una producción perfecta: queremos ver cómo explicas y cómo haces sencillo lo difícil.
4. Entrevista. Si tu clase encaja, te invitaremos a una entrevista para conocerte mejor, comentar tu clase y hablar de los proyectos en los que podrías colaborar.
Si conoces el camino hacia una plaza y quieres ayudar a otros a recorrerlo, queremos conocerte.

title: Director of E-commerce Supply Chain
description:
Position: Director of Supply Chain
Department: Supply Chain & Logistics
Employer Company : EAK Distribution
Reports To: COO / Integrator
Job Type: Full Time, Remote
Salary: Up to $4000
Work Hours: 8 AM - 12 PM EST, with flexibility to coordinate with external partners in PST and occasional communication with Chinese suppliers.
Role (Overview of the Position)
The Director of Supply Chain is a senior leadership role responsible for building and managing the end-to-end supply chain infrastructure that will scale HOME GROWN from ~$20M to $100M+ in revenue. This position owns the full physical flow of goods: raw material procurement (domestic and international), vendor management including overseas finished goods suppliers, production coordination with Heirloom Organics, inventory planning and demand forecasting, inbound/outbound logistics, and multi-channel fulfillment across Amazon FBA, TikTok Shop (MCF and FBT), Shopify, Home Depot dropship, and future retail partners.
Reporting to the COO/Integrator, the Director of Supply Chain leads the logistics team, owns the supply chain budget, and serves as the primary driver of ERP selection and implementation. This role must build the systems, processes, and team capable of supporting 600+ SKUs within two years while maintaining a stockout rate below 1%.
This is not a maintenance role. The company is in a high-growth phase with expanding channels, a vertically integrated manufacturing facility, and plans to 5x revenue. The Director of Supply Chain must be someone who has built supply chain infrastructure at scale and thrives in environments where the playbook has not been written yet.
Responsibilities (Tasks Associated with the Role)
Demand Planning & Inventory Strategy

• Own the demand planning function across all channels and all SKUs (180 today, scaling to 600+ within two years).

• Build and maintain rolling demand forecasts that integrate sales velocity, seasonality, promotional calendars, and channel expansion timelines.

• Maintain a stockout rate below 1% across all active SKUs while minimizing overstock and dead inventory.

• Establish safety stock models, reorder points, and lead time buffers for each product category and channel.

• Coordinate cross-functionally with Sales, Brand Management, andProduct Development to align forecasts with planned launches, promotions, and channel expansions.

Procurement & Vendor Management

• Consolidate and own all procurement across entities: raw seeds (via Heirloom Organics), envelopes, mylars, soil, pots, packaging materials, and finished goods from overseas and domestic suppliers.

• Manage international supplier relationships including overseas finished goods vendors: lead times, import logistics, customs/duties, and quality assurance.

• Negotiate supplier contracts, pricing, lead times, and quality standards.

• Build a diversified vendor base that reduces single-source risk as SKU count scales.

• Manage purchase order workflows and ensure alignment between procurement spend and approved budgets.

Heirloom Organics Production Coordination

• Serve as the primary supply chain interface with Mark (Operations Lead) and the Heirloom Organics team in Grants Pass, OR.

• Translate demand forecasts into production requirements and ensure production schedules align with fulfillment timelines.

• Track production output against commitments. Escalate and problem-solve when production falls behind plan.

• Collaborate on capacity planning as SKU count and volume grow, including equipment utilization (seed counters, bag packers, labeling lines).

Logistics & Fulfillment

• Oversee all inbound freight (vendor to warehouse/FBA/FBT) and outbound fulfillment operations.

• Manage Amazon FBA compliance: IPI score maintenance (450+), restock limits, stranded inventory resolution, shipment plan optimization.

• Manage TikTok Shop fulfillment across both Amazon MCF and Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT), including inventory allocation to TikTok warehouses.

title: Policy Research, Strategic Advisory
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We're hiring a policy generalist to join the Strategic Advisory team within Anthropic's Public Policy team. You'll develop and maintain our policy research strategy and lead the research behind it, to strengthen Anthropic's policy influence in Washington and around the world.

You'll lead the research that backs up Anthropic's policy positions: deciding what evidence a position needs, working with Anthropic's research teams on what our own data can show, building partnerships with outside academics, think tanks and economists, and managing our growing body of commissioned research and economic impact work. You'll turn that research into analysis and materials our federal, state and international teams can use. You'll also run the cross-functional processes that take an open policy question to an agreed, evidence-backed position. As Anthropic's international footprint grows, you'll help the team scale its research and support for markets outside the US.

You're likely a strong generalist who likes to build things and see them through, and who gets energy from turning complex research into something clear, organized and useful. You're curious and rigorous about evidence. You ask what would change a skeptic's mind, you can tell a strong study from a weak one, and you know when to bring in a subject matter expert. You have good judgment, you take initiative, and you're comfortable when the path isn't defined yet. You can run several research projects and outside partners at once while keeping track of how they connect.

Key responsibilities

• Run policy development processes from open question to agreed position: frame the question, bring in the right experts from research, legal, communications and regional policy teams, work through disagreements, and get to a decision

• Develop research plans for priority issue areas: what evidence would strengthen or test a position, what Anthropic's own data and research can show, and where an outside partner is the right source

• Work with Anthropic's research teams, including economics research, Societal Impacts and the Frontier Red Team, to turn their findings into material policymakers can use

• Manage commissioned research from scoping through publication, and build partnerships with outside academics, think tanks, economists and consultancies

• Own economic impact reports and the narratives that go with them for markets around the world

• Anticipate emerging policy issues and work with internal experts to develop Anthropic's perspective and supporting materials before external pressure builds

• Scale the team's support for international markets: adapt strategy and materials for different governments, and build templates and processes so each new market is faster than the last

• Draft briefings, talking points and other materials on short timelines, coordinating with policy communications so messaging stays consistent

Minimum qualifications

• A track record of driving cross-functional projects to a decision or finished product, including getting people with competing interests to agreement when you don't manage them

• Experience as a policy generalist across several issue areas, including designing and carrying out policy research and turning it into policy proposals or positions

• Ability to scope a research question, work with economists, academics and other experts to answer it, and judge the quality of their evidence and methods, for example through economic consulting, a policy research organization, or an in-house research team

• Excellent writing: you can turn complex technical or economic material into clear, concise

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

The company provides innovative hire solutions, safety signage, and building products to the construction and building industries, supporting residential and commercial projects as well as major events across Australia. Renowned for its exceptional customer service and attention to detail, they are committed to delivering reliable solutions that improve worksite safety, efficiency, and productivity while ensuring workers return home safely every day
ROLE OVERVIEW:
We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Finance & Administration Officer to support the financial and administrative operations of an Australian business. This role is responsible for ensuring the accurate and timely processing of accounts payable, payroll, contractor payments, overhire invoicing, reconciliations, reporting, and administrative support.
The successful candidate will work closely with internal stakeholders to maintain financial accuracy, support business operations, respond to customer and supplier enquiries, and ensure compliance with company processes and workplace requirements.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a structured environment, enjoys working with numbers, and takes pride in delivering accurate, high-quality work.
RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Accounts Payable (10%): Process supplier invoices accurately, verify purchase orders where applicable (approximately 1-10% of orders may include a PO), reconcile supplier statements, and escalate accounts payable queries to the Group Accountant.

• Contractor Invoice Management (20%): Review contractor invoices against run sheets and reports, resolve discrepancies, and maintain documentation.

• Payroll Administration (10%): Process weekly and fortnightly payroll, reimbursements, and maintain payroll records.

• Accounts Receivable Support (10%): Provide AR backup support, assist with collections, and escalate overdue accounts when required.

• Overhires Invoicing Processing (20%): Process overhire invoicing. Initially support the process currently managed by a Virtual Assistant (VA), with the intention of becoming familiar with the role so the function can be shared across the team.

• Cross Charge Invoicing (5%): Process weekly cross-charge invoicing for a designated division of the business. This task is completed weekly and generally requires approximately one hour.

• Reconciliations & Reporting (10%): Assist with daily bank reconciliations in Xero.

• Administration Support (5%): Perform filing, data entry, phone management, document control, tax return preparation support, and ad hoc administration tasks.

• Stakeholder Service (5%): Respond to customer and supplier queries, resolve account issues, and maintain strong stakeholder relationships.

• Health, Safety & Compliance (5%): Support OH&S compliance, safety training, incident reporting, and workplace injury administration

Requirements

• Previous experience in a Finance & Administration, Accounts, or similar role.

• Experience processing Accounts Payable and supplier invoices.

• Experience with payroll administration, including weekly and/or fortnightly payroll.

• Experience supporting Accounts Receivable and invoice processing.

• Experience performing bank reconciliations using Xero.

• Strong attention to detail with excellent numerical accuracy.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

• Excellent organizational and time management skills.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Benefits

• Full time remote/WFH set up

• Dayshift - Australian Business Hours

Wir sind ein erfolgsorientiertes Unternehmen und folgen dem Prinzip „Hire for attitude, train for skill" und bilden Dich in allen relevanten Dingen aus! title: Senior Creative Strategist
description:
About Sidekick

At Sidekick , we help people recover faster from injuries. Trusted by Olympic champions and everyday athletes, our products have been featured in Men's Health and Running Magazine . With 94% of users finding relief, we aim to be the go-to injury relief brand.
The role
A lot of performance creative work goes into creating demand that wasn't there. That's not the problem here. Our customer already wants what we sell. Their heel hurts every morning when they get out of bed, or their ankle rolls on uneven ground and they've stopped trusting it.
What they don't believe is that this is the thing that finally works. They've already bought the insoles, done the stretches, and gone to physio twice. So you have to teach before you can sell, and you have to earn trust from someone who has been let down already. It's a harder brief than most, and a more interesting one.
You'll write our paid social advertising and own angle development and testing, reporting to our Creative Director. Expect to ship around 15 briefs a week, a mix of net-new concepts and iterations on ads that are already working. Your week is writing, research, and feedback to editors.
You don't need a physiotherapy background, but you do need to pick up a clinical concept quickly enough to explain it clearly and honestly in fifteen seconds of camera time.
What you'll do

•
Find new winning angles. Better creative is what lets us spend more, so we need a steady supply of ads that keep working as budgets grow.

•
Open new audiences. Runners, older adults worried about falling, people on their feet all day. Each group buys for a different reason, and every one we crack opens up new demand.

•
Get more life out of winners. Read the data weekly, iterate what's working, retire what's finished.

•
Write the scripts. Short and long-form video, hooks that stop the scroll, dialogue that sounds like a real person. This is most of your week.

•
Direct the edit. Brief and manage editors and creators so the idea survives production.

•
Extend what wins. Take proven angles into landing pages and email.

Requirements
What we're looking for

• 4+ years writing paid social ads that were judged on sales (not brand awareness, engagement etc.)

• Your ads have been responsible for over $100K+/month in ad spend (across all your ads, for a single brand). We'll ask you to walk us through it.

• Proof you can iterate on a winner. Plenty of people can write one good ad; we want someone who gets eight more out of it.

• You've opened a new audience before, and you can name the angle that got you in

• Excellent writing for spoken word, which is a different skill from writing for the page

• Strong direct response fundamentals: offer, mechanism, objection handling, proof

• Experience briefing editors or creators

• Health, fitness or medical device categories are a plus

What we care about
We want people who are ambitious and hold themselves to a high standard. They don't need to be managed closely, and want to be the best at their craft. The volume is real and the feedback is direct. In exchange you'll see more results in a year than most people see in three. If you're looking for something comfortable, this won't be the right fit for you.
Benefits

• Compensation: Top of the market for this role. We’ll share compensation details on the first call.

• Fast-growing company whose mission is to solve chronic pain and injuries

• You’ll see the direct impact of your work on business results

• You’ll be held to a high bar, which means you’ll get better fast

• Fun, approachable yet ambitious colleagues

• Comprehensive health benefits

• Work from home

title: Search Engineer, AI Infrastructure (SF)
description:
Lavendo partners with startups and high‑growth companies to help them hire top‑tier sales, GTM, and technical talent. This role is with one of our clients; we’ll share full details about the company and interview process as we get to know you and confirm mutual fit.
About the Company
Our client builds the data layer that AI agents run on. One API call turns any URL into clean, structured, LLM-ready data. It is already the default way a huge number of developers pull web data into their AI systems.
The numbers back it up: 8 figures in ARR in year one, more than doubled that in year two, and 125,000+ GitHub stars. They just closed a $75M Series B. The company is small, moving fast, and hiring people who want to build the next chapter with them.
The Mission
They believe developers and AI agents should not have to fight the web to get useful data out of it. Every hour spent maintaining a scraper, dealing with stale pages, or working around brittle retrieval systems is an hour taken away from the actual product.
Their job is to make that problem disappear: give AI systems reliable access to the live web, then make the results clean, current, structured, and useful enough to power real products.
The Opportunity
As a Search Engineer , you will own the systems that turn the open web into a high-quality search index.
You will work directly with the Head of Search and a small team to build and improve the crawling, indexing, retrieval, ranking, and serving infrastructure behind a fast-growing search product. This is an end-to-end role: you will improve relevance while solving the real constraints of search at scale - freshness, deduplication, latency, reliability, and cost per query.
The key requirement is direct production ownership of ranking and relevance. You should be able to point to a search-quality change you personally shipped and the metric it improved.
What You’ll Do

• Own ranking quality and relevance for LLM-driven search and retrieval

• Build and operate the crawling, indexing, retrieval, and search-serving systems behind the product.

• Improve search quality using lexical, semantic, hybrid, and reranking approaches

• Reduce latency and cost per query as query volume and corpus size grow, without compromising relevance, correctness, or reliability

• Own systems end to end: design, build, deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, measure, and iterate in production

• Solve for freshness, incremental indexing, deduplication, crawl scheduling, and large-scale corpus management

• Work directly with the Head of Search and the team to shape the roadmap and ship customer-facing improvements quickly

What You Bring

• 3+ years building and operating production search or retrieval systems, with direct ownership of ranking and relevance

• A specific example of a ranking or reranking change you owned and the measurable impact it had on relevance, recall, conversion, CTR, NDCG, MRR, or a similar metric

• Hands-on information-retrieval depth across BM25/lexical, semantic/vector, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and retrieval or RAG evaluation

• Strong backend and distributed-systems skills in Go, Rust, Python, or a comparable language, with end-to-end production ownership

• Experience improving latency and cost at meaningful query volume while maintaining quality and reliability

• Familiarity with search and infrastructure tooling such as Lucene, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Redis, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS/GCP, gRPC, or Protobuf

Key Success Drivers
The people who do well here have personally owned search quality in production, think end-to-end about relevance, crawling, indexing, serving, latency, and cost, and thrive in ambiguity by shipping, measuring, and iterating quickly without needing a fully defined playbook.
Why Join?

• Compensation & Equity: Base salary of $235K-$260K+. Meaningful equity in a fast-growing, well-funded startup

• Traction: 8 figures in ARR in year one, more than doubled in year two. 125,000+ GitH

About NOCD
NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD , we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.
About the Role
As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD , we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.
NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LPCC, LMFT, LCSW) in New Mexico to join our team.
As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.
You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.
What You'll Do

• Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform

• Manage your caseload and schedule

• Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system

• Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD

• Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

• See credentialing information here.

•

• 40 hour work week

• Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week

• Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders.

• Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation

• Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions

• Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding

• Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training

• Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).

•

• If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.

• Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

• Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.

• Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required

title: Elementary Physical Education - College Lesson Editor (Contract)
description:
Elementary Physical Education - College Lesson Editor

We are seeking detail‑oriented Elementary Physical Education Experts to review and revise college-level lessons. You will check to confirm the accuracy and clarity of lessons to ensure our content is a great resource for students.

This is a remote contractor role. You’ll work independently, manage your own time, and follow clear documentation to ensure consistent, high‑quality outcomes.

All work is paid hourly.

Job Description:

The subject-matter expert will carefully perform accuracy checks on provided college-level lessons. Minor edits may be required if the lesson is inaccurate in any way, and the expert must be capable of confirming that lessons are coherent and helpful for our users.

What You’ll Do

- Follow internal documentation to improve content accuracy and quality of provided lessons
- Review and approve college-level lessons in **Elementary Physical Education**
- Verify content is accurate, on-level, and appropriate for the related course

What Makes You a Great Fit

- Subject-matter expertise in **Elementary Physical Education**
- Strong editorial judgment for educational materials, with an eye for clarity, fairness, and learner‑appropriate rigor
- Ability to work independently and follow structured procedures

Required Qualifications

- A bachelor’s degree in Elementary Education, Physical Education, or Health
- 3-5 years of teaching experience in **Elementary Physical Education**
- Experience editing or developing educational content, assessments, or test‑prep materials
- Excellent written English and command of grammar, syntax, and tone for adult learners
- Familiarity with DEI guidelines for content publication
- Reliable internet and your own computer

Preferred Qualifications
Master’s degree in Elementary Education, Physical Education, or Health
College teaching experience in Elementary Education, Physical Education, or Health
Experience with content management systems

What We Offer:

•
Reliable Payments: You'll receive payments twice a month and automated invoicing for your work.

•
Remote Work: This is a fully online contracted work-from-home opportunity.

•
Flexibility: Basically, there are no requirements! Work when you want, where you want, as often as you want, with no minimums/maximums.

•
Support: Our supportive staff is available answer your questions and help you get up and running.

The Contract Process

• Complete the application and submit with your resume.

• Applications are approved and contracts sent on Wednesdays.

• Submit the contract within the 5-day signing window.

• The following Wednesday, you’ll receive onboarding instructions.

You can view a step-by-step overview of the contract process here: How to Become a Freelancer with Study.com

About Study.com

The mission of Study.com is to make education accessible, and over the last two decades we’ve become the leading online education platform, delivering a personalized learning experience across a broad continuum of education for over 30 million students, instructors, and professionals every month.

We help empower millions of learners to achieve their education and career goals. We focus on increasing access to education because we know information is the ultimate equalizer and that education is key to upward mobility.

Feel free to share this opportunity with any friends you think would be interested, too.

title: Head of Foodservice
description:
Confido is the AI infrastructure powering modern CPG - the platform that 200+ brands like OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Dr. Squatch, and Tropicana use to run everything from deductions to production planning. Finance, accounting, sales, and operations, unified in one system for the first time.

We're growing 5x year over year with a small team in New York City; the people who join now will shape the product, the culture, and the company itself.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere - and outsized ownership while you build - we'd love to meet you.

THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Head of Foodservice to lead how Confido serves the channel. Foodservice brands often struggle to see who’s buying their products and connect that activity to what they’re owed and what they spend. You’ll help turn that visibility into automated order-to-cash, better trade planning, and recovered revenue - setting priorities with Product and Engineering, guiding our customer implementations, and shaping how Confido shows up in the foodservice market.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Product & Engineering

- Shape the foodservice roadmap with Product and Engineering, and set business priorities, validate designs, and ensure we're solving the most important foodservice challenges

- Turn foodservice processes into clear product requirements across integrations, pricing, billback validation, contracts and bids, GPO programs, accruals, and forecasting

- Synthesize customer feedback and market intelligence into actionable product insights

Customers

- Lead discovery and design sessions with foodservice brands, from AR and deductions teams to trade, sales, and operations leaders

- Guide customers through foodservice implementation on Confido, and train brands on how to manage their foodservice business in the platform, from validating billbacks to planning spend

- Act as the go-to foodservice expert and partner with Customer Success to shape QBR messaging and address escalations related to complex foodservice problems

Go-to-Market

- Be Confido's voice in foodservice with customers, prospects, partners and at industry events

- Collaborate with sales and marketing teams on discovery calls, deal support, content, and webinars

- Track shifts in how brands, distributors, and GPOs price, plan and operate, and turn them into insights for the broader team

WHAT YOU BRING

Must Have:

- 7+ years of hands-on foodservice experience at a CPG manufacturer, broker, distributor or GPO, in trade, revenue management, sales operations, deductions or finance

- Deep knowledge of foodservice pricing and contracts across distributors, operators and GPOs

- Working knowledge of GPOs and foodservice management companies such as Compass/Foodbuy, Sodexo, Aramark/Avendra, Premier and HPSI

- Strong cross-functional communicator, equally comfortable with a customer's finance lead, distributor partner, or product manager

- Strategic thinker who can see where the foodservice channel is headed and how technology should change the way brands manage it

- Ability to translate business processes into product requirements and work closely with engineers

- Willingness to work at our NYC Headquarters 5 days a week

Nice to Have:

- Functional expertise in a specific foodservice segment: Restaurants, K-12, College & University, Healthcare, Workplace Dining, Lodging, Travel & Recreation, Military & Government, etc.

- Experience with foodservice TPM, contract management or deduction software

- Familiarity with foodservice data sources such as distributor depletion reports, Meal Ticket, and CREST

🌴 PERKS + BENEFITS

- Equity - own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build

- Fully paid health coverage through Aetna - we cover 100% of employee premiums

- Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian

- Carrot Fertility Pro - comprehensive fertility and family-forming support

- 12 weeks of paid parental leave

- Unlimited PTO - plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take

- 401(k
